identity.title: Aggregate governed outcome across independent execution scopes

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Derive a deterministic run-level governed outcome from scope-level outcomes without collapsing lifecycle, native execution outcome, and governance judgment into one status.
human_pressure.why_now: Real EverRun runs contain accepted scopes and review-required scopes inside one completed run; current run-centric semantics are too coarse.
do_not_misread: Do not add EverRun statuses such as COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS to Ailuros enums.
Do not make lifecycle equal governance outcome.
Do not treat one successful scope as proof that the whole run is clean.
red_lines: Use existing generic Outcome/GovernedOutcome concepts where sufficient.

machine_core.goal: Add the smallest deterministic aggregation semantics needed to represent multi-scope governed execution while preserving current single-scope behavior.
red_lines: Do not import producer lifecycle vocabulary.
Do not infer clean success from incomplete coverage.
Do not add scoring or probabilistic aggregation.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path unrelated to existing governance facts.
invariants: Lifecycle describes execution completion, not governance cleanliness.
A review-required scoped outcome prevents run-level clean success.
A failed governance scope has precedence over clean/degraded success.
Unknown scope outcomes remain visible and must not be silently promoted to clean.

producer.artifact: scope-aware execution projections and governance records

observable_effect.assertion: A run with mixed scoped outcomes receives a deterministic generic governed outcome while preserving native lifecycle/outcome separately.

proofs.assertion: Outcome precedence tests cover clean+review, clean+failed, clean+unknown, degraded, and single-scope compatibility.

failure_semantics: Insufficient scope evidence yields unknown/review according to existing required-evidence semantics, never clean by omission.
Contradictory unsupported aggregation remains unknown rather than guessed.

steps.title: Define scope outcome inputs
details: Use only canonical scope-aware governance facts already implemented by prior packs.

steps.title: Add deterministic aggregation precedence
details: Preserve separate lifecycle/native outcome/governed outcome semantics and use existing enums where possible.

steps.title: Expose aggregate without producer vocabulary
details: Ensure reports can represent mixed-scope governance without importing EverRun statuses.

steps.title: Prove precedence
details: Add focused tests for mixed and single-scope cases.

acceptance: Lifecycle remains separate from governance outcome.
No producer-specific status enum is introduced.
Unknown does not become clean by omission.

must_check: Aggregation uses generic scope facts only.
reject_if: COMPLETED_WITH_WARNINGS or producer status is added to canonical enums.
Run completion is treated as clean governance success.
Unknown scopes are ignored to make the run clean.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Governed-outcome and precedence suites are the canonical behavior checks; full suite protects reports and compatibility.
